<main id="main">
<section class="hero wrap">
<div class="hero-copy">
FOR SOLOPRENEURS AND PROFESSIONALS
Your work has grown. Does your website help convert the work you want?

Bring your best work out of old decks, notes, and project folders. We’ll use Claude Code or Codex to build a website that shows your value and set up an AI operating system to organize your work and keep your site current.
Build with AI. Without the AI slop.

I’m ready to build

$1,500 USD / participant
Course kicks off in January.
<div class="hero-art" aria-label="Ariba Jahan’s website, brand book, and custom CMS, examples of what you will learn to build">
● ● ●aribajahan.com

YOUR BRAND BOOK
MAKE IT
YOUR OWN.
TYPE / COLOR / COMPONENTS / MOTION
YOUR CUSTOM CMSYOUR CONTENT. YOUR CONTROLS.
Built by Ariba Jahan. The process is what you’ll learn.
</section>

Put AI to work for you

Build an AI operating system around your projects, ideas, and ambitions. Give AI the context to help you turn what you know into work you can use.

I’m in this with you

An intimate group, candid feedback, and my product, growth, and design expertise applied directly to what you’re building.

A website that opens doors

Make your expertise clear to the right people, with a site you’re proud to share and can easily update as your work grows.
<section class="outputs wrap section" id="outputs">
What you’ll build
<div class="output-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Explore workshop outputs">
<div class="output-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-site" aria-labelledby="tab-site" tabindex="0">

Work out what belongs on each page, then design and build it around your expertise and the work you want to show.

  • Your pages: communicate your expertise, showcase your work, and give visitors a clear next step.
  • Desktop and mobile: adapt layouts, navigation, images, and content to each screen.
  • Your analytics: connect Google Analytics to see how people find your site and which pages they visit.
  • Your launch: connect your own domain and add your favicon, the small icon in browser tabs and bookmarks.

You own the code and content, with the ability to move hosts.

DESKTOP
MOBILE

Explore two sites I’ve built: My website · The Reading Room
<div class="output-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-brand" aria-labelledby="tab-brand" tabindex="0" hidden>

Create a visual language you love, then build the system that keeps it consistent.

  • Your visual identity: a logo or wordmark treatment, typography, color palette, and imagery direction.
  • Your components: consistent styles for buttons, links, and recurring page layouts.
  • Your AI reference: a brand book you can give your AI so future changes follow your design direction.
  • Room to evolve: learn how to update the system as your work and preferences grow.

Use your visual language across your site and future materials.
<div class="output-panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-cms" aria-labelledby="tab-cms" tabindex="0" hidden>

Build the controls for the parts of your site you want to update yourself. Start with your everyday content, then learn how to make more of your site editable as your needs change.

  • Your content: copy, projects, case studies, and testimonials.
  • Your media library: upload, organize, and reuse images across your site.
  • Your SEO settings: page titles, descriptions, URLs, and image alt text.
  • Your share previews: choose the image, title, and description supplied when someone shares your site on LinkedIn or in a message.
  • Your site controls: choose which links, calls to action, and page sections you want to manage.
Ariba Jahan’s CMS. You’ll build a simpler version around your own content.
</section>

The workshop series

I’ll demonstrate each step, then you’ll apply it to your own site.
Prework assignment will be shared.
<div class="session-list">

01Set up and explore your site’s purpose+

We’ll set up your project folders and get you into the AI tools. Then we’ll start exploring who you want to reach, what you want your site to do for you, and which work you’ll gather to show what you bring.

02Site purpose and design direction+

I’ll walk you through real sites so we can look at what makes someone understand an offer and take the next step. We’ll use those examples to decide what belongs on your site, how to present your work or package your services, and what design direction fits.

03Build your homepage+

Move the design into Claude Code or Codex. Build the homepage and design its desktop and mobile layouts. Adapt navigation, image crops, section order, and interactions for each screen; test on your phone and practice giving the AI specific feedback. Extend those patterns to your remaining pages between sessions.

You’ll work on: a working homepage and a repeatable way to build the rest.

04Make it yours to update+

Build on a prepared CMS foundation. Choose the content fields and controls you need. Connect the editor to your copy, images, projects, testimonials, and page-level SEO settings. Practice adding a case study and checking the result before publishing.

You’ll work on: an editor configured for your site and a tested content update.

05Get ready to launch+

Check mobile layouts, links, contact routes, and accessibility basics. Set page titles, descriptions, and social-sharing images. Connect your own Google Analytics account and verify a visit. Work through connecting your domain and publishing, then practice making a change and restoring an earlier version. Create a slash command for a repeatable task, such as checking a page before publishing.

You’ll work toward: a published site, with a clear list of anything still needed before launch.

06Flexible office hours and site feedback+

Bring questions from your preparation, build, or launch. I may split the group office hours into shorter sessions at different points so you can get help when it is most useful. Each participant also gets a bookable 30-minute individual session with Ariba Jahan.

Bring: your site, the change you want to make, or the thing you’re stuck on.
Make time to build between sessions. I’ll guide your preparation and help you work through questions as you go.
</section>
<section class="tools-section" id="tools" aria-labelledby="tools-title"><div class="wrap">

Tools we’ll use

I’ll guide you through setup and show you how to use each tool as we build.

Claude Design

Explore design directions and develop your brand book.

Claude Code or Codex

Build and update your site by working with AI on files on your computer.
We’ll use Next.js and React for the site, GitHub to track changes, and Vercel to publish it.
<section class="tools-workspace" id="workspace" aria-labelledby="workspace-title">
The AI operating system we’ll build
Keep your project files, brand book, and instructions together on your computer so AI can use them each time you come back to the work.

Project context

Give AI your brief, voice, and design choices to refer to as you build.

Reusable skills

Save instructions for work you do often, like writing a case study in your voice.

Slash commands

Run a repeatable task with a shortcut, like checking a page before publishing.
</section>

Build with me.

Ariba Jahan

I’ve led product, innovation, and digital experience work at the Ad Council and Anomaly. I built my own site with AI and documented the decisions behind it.

Now we’ll apply that experience to yours. I’ll work with you on how your site communicates your value, give you direct design feedback, and guide you through directing the AI.

Join the January cohort

Course kicks off in January. Sessions begin January 7, on Thursdays at 1 p.m. ET, for 60–90 minutes, with flexible office hours.

ENROLLMENT

$1,500USD / participant

Includes a 30-minute one-on-one with Ariba Jahan.

Join the January cohort

Tool subscriptions, domain, and hosting costs are separate.

Before you join

Who is this for?+

For solopreneurs and professionals who want a digital presence that reflects their expertise and ambition—whether you’re growing a business, exploring your next role, or making room for what comes next.

How is this different from other courses?+

We’re not just vibing. We’re using strategy and design judgment. We’ll build with AI while making deliberate choices about your brand, how your site communicates your value, and the experience people have using it. I’ll help you evaluate what’s working and guide what needs to change.

You’ll set up a local AI workspace and create a CMS you can keep updating as your work evolves. The group is intentionally small so you can ask me questions directly and get feedback on your own work throughout.

What do I need to get started?+

No prior experience with these tools is needed. Bring a computer and a paid Claude account, and set aside time between sessions to work on your site. I’ll guide what you need to pull together with a thorough checklist, examples, and inspiration, including the accounts, copy, images, and work samples we’ll use. I’ll share the preparation guide before the course begins.

Our goal is to get your website live. Your progress will depend on the content you bring, the work you do between sessions, and the scope of your site. I’ll help you focus on the pages and features you need most and identify anything that needs more time.

We’ll set up your local AI workspace together, then work through GitHub, hosting, and connecting your domain. I’ll explain each tool and guide you through the setup. Your site will use Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with your AI coding agent.

Tool subscriptions, your domain, and hosting are separate from the workshop fee; I’ll make those requirements and costs clear before enrollment.

What can I update afterward?+

Use your CMS to edit copy, manage your media library, add projects or case studies, manage testimonials, and update SEO settings. Connect your own Google Analytics account to understand visits to your site. For layout changes or new features, work with your AI coding agent, check the result, and publish the change.

What does it cost?+

Enrollment is $1,500 USD per participant. Tool subscriptions, hosting, and your domain may carry separate costs; those requirements will be made clear before enrollment.

How will the schedule work?+

Course kicks off in January. Our first session is January 7, 2027. We meet Thursdays at 1 p.m. ET (10 a.m. PT / 6 p.m. UK), for 60–90 minutes. I’ll share the remaining session dates before we begin.

Office hours provide time for questions and site feedback. I may split them into shorter sessions before and during the build, placing the support where the group needs it most. I’ll confirm those times with you.

If you miss a session, I’ll share a recording of the teaching portion and the session instructions so you can catch up.

If the timing is your only hesitation, email me. With a small group, there may be room to adjust the schedule together.

Can’t make this round?+

Send me a note and I’ll keep you posted when the next cohort opens. It goes straight to my inbox. I’d love to hear what you’re hoping to build.

Keep me posted

Can I book additional individual feedback?+

Yes. You can add a 60-minute review with me for $350. Choose website feedback, offer productization and strategy, or custom site feature planning. Email me if you’d like to add it.

This is additional to the 30-minute individual session included in your enrollment.

Will I own my website?+

Yes. You own the code and content, and your domain and hosting accounts are yours. Once your new site is live and your domain is connected, you can finally cancel that Squarespace website subscription. You’ll still need a domain and hosting for your new site.

Want to build your AI skills with one-on-one support?

Work directly with me on what you want to build or do differently with AI. We’ll use your own projects and work through it together.

Explore one-on-one sessions

Let’s build something you’re proud to put your name on.

You’ve put a lot into your work. Let’s give it a home you’re proud to share.

Wondering whether this is right for you? Email me and tell me what you have in mind.
